Healing Lore +17: Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a 17% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Devotion +115: Passive: +115 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Insightful Devotion +57: Passive: +57 Insight bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Quality Magical Sheltering +6: +6 Quality bonus to Magical Resistance Rating
